sources.title: Raw Cainiao interview note preserving the 100-million package interval question
Normalized tagged package interval peak question
Package interval peak deterministic and randomized Java validation

claims.text: The source asks for the peak time range and duration from one day of package put/take timestamps plus time and space complexity; it does not prescribe timestamp precision, endpoint semantics, programming language, Difference Array, or Sweep Line.
Half-open [put,take) intervals, nonnegative integer time offsets, returning all peak segments and total peak duration, and Java are explicit answer-side choices rather than source facts.

The grouped endpoint sweep matches a discrete brute-force occupancy oracle across 12,000 seeded randomized interval sets and dedicated simultaneous-boundary, disjoint-peak, large-timestamp and invalid-input cases.
